title: Improving O-RADS Risk Stratification from Ultrasound Reports: A Comparative Evaluation of Hybrid versus End-to-End LLM Reasoning Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2608.23061v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: Automating clinical guideline-based decision-making with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging because of reliability, hallucination, and limited interpretability. We compared the performance of LLMs and reasoning strategies for automated Ovarian-Adnexal Reporting and Data System (O-RADS) classification from free-text pelvic ultrasound reports. Methods: In this retrospective study, consecutive patients with ovarian masses who underwent pelvic ultrasound were included. Eight LLMs were tested with three reasoning strategies: implicit-knowledge end-to-end, rule-informed end-to-end, and a feature-based hybrid architecture that decoupled feature extraction from rule-based classification. The reference standard was O-RADS categorization established by expert consensus. Results: A total of 310 women with 390 ovarian masses were evaluated. translated_title: 改进基于超声报告的O-RADS风险分层：混合式与端到端大语言模型推理策略的比较评估
translated_abstract: 摘要：背景：使用大型语言模型（LLMs）自动化基于临床指南的决策仍然具有挑战性，因为存在可靠性、幻觉和可解释性有限的问题。我们比较了LLMs和推理策略在从自由文本盆腔超声报告中自动进行卵巢-附件报告和数据系统（O-RADS）分类方面的性能。方法：在这项回顾性研究中，纳入了连续就诊的患有卵巢肿块并接受盆腔超声检查的患者。测试了八个LLMs，采用三种推理策略：隐式知识端到端、规则引导端到端，以及一种基于特征的混合架构，该架构将特征提取与基于规则的分类解耦。参考标准是由专家共识建立的O-RADS分类。结果：共评估了310名女性，包含390个卵巢肿块。使用Gemini 3.6 Flash的基于特征的混合架构表现出最佳的...
tldr: 该研究提出并验证了一种基于特征的混合LLM推理架构，通过将特征提取与规则分类解耦，在O-RADS风险分层中显著优于传统的端到端推理策略，提高了自动化临床决策的可靠性和可解释性。
en_tdlr: This study proposes and validates a feature-based hybrid LLM reasoning architecture that decouples feature extraction from rule-based classification, significantly outperforming end-to-end reasoning strategies in O-RADS risk stratification, enhancing reliability and interpretability of automated clinical decision-making.
